organism.chronoseries_note: No predecessor or successor chronospecies is in this slot. At 0 Ma the extant pod carries both the 69.12 µm cellular mode and the centimetre-scale valve. They are simultaneous, not a temporal replacement.

scale.label: 69 µm
scale.statement: Characteristic scale 69.12 µm (6.912e-05 m, log10 = -4.160), tier 4_cellular_10um detail variant. Age 0 Ma, Holocene extant.

scale_boundary_versus_neighbours.tier_centre_10_um: A 10 µm wavelength would sit inside one epidermal cell. This slot does not select that mode.
scale_boundary_versus_neighbours.this_mode_69_12_um: k_c = 2π/69.12 µm⁻¹. Along the printed 1 cm bar the mode repeats 144 times and a 145th does not fit (144×69.12 = 9953.28 µm).
scale_boundary_versus_neighbours.organ_scale_armon_2011: Armon et al. 2011 (doi:10.1126/science.1203874) is the centimetre-scale incompatible-shell law for the same species. It is cited only as the scale boundary. Its curvature parameters are not used.

equations.formula: u_t = D_u ∇²u + a - u + u^2 v;  v_t = D_v ∇²v + b - u^2 v
k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v);  lambda_c = 2π / k_c

state_variables.role: activator (mapped to darker tannin in the render)

boundary_conditions: Periodic on a flat 8 × 6 wavelength epidermal patch (552.96 µm × 414.72 µm). Not the curved valve surface. The photograph's silhouette is measured, not generated by the PDE.

parameters.provenance: above the discriminant root 8.5676 for this (a, b)

empirical_claims.claim: A homogeneous steady state can be unstable at a finite wavenumber when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator, selecting λ = 2π/k_c.
The trimolecular system a - u + u^2 v, b - u^2 v has the steady state used above.
empirical_claims.status: reported_in_source; the spatial Turing use is a later coupling, not a result of that paper

empirical_claims.claim: Bauhinia variegata pod valves open by incompatible curvature at centimetre scale.
empirical_claims.status: reported_in_source; not the law implemented in this slot

empirical_claims.claim: The 69.12 µm pigment spacing was measured on this pericarp.
empirical_claims.status: not claimed. The length is the assigned detail scale. On this scan the 1 cm bar is 37 px, so 69.12 µm is 0.256 px and is not resolved.
